name: Responsive Image Style Builder
description: auto-creates image styles connected to theme breakpoints.
project_description:
This module automatically creates image styles that are connected to theme breakpoints with new responsive image styles.

 Back to top 

 Wait, what? 
 Because the creation of responsive image styles is decoupled of image styles, there's a need to simplify this procedure.

Which is why this module is created.

 Back to top 

 How? 
 
 Install the module like you would with any other module 
 Add a responsive image style with any given name, with the active theme breakpoint group 
 Check your image styles after saved 
 See that this module created an image style for each breakpoint and multiplier 
 
 Back to top 

 Wow? 
 Yeah, we know. The idea behind this is that the module should improve the workflow for creating responsive image styles for site builders. So if you have an idea that follows this general idea, feel free to add it to the issue queue.

 Back to top 

 What's next? 
 Well, if you must ask, we have a (current) roadmap worked out:

 
 Generate a new fallback image style (optionally) + add default effects 
 Optionally copy the fallback image style for each breakpoint and multiplier when creating a new responsive image style + effects 
 Apply effects to child image styles when editing/adding effects, and their repective weight. 
 Optionally add effect to parent when updating/adding effect to child 
 Set cropping height and weight when adding responsive image style per breakpoint when creating 
 Hide obsolete (required) fields in forms 
 
 Back to top 

 That is? 
 Yep, that's all there is to it.

 Stay awesome!
